text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки has been overtaken by
exhaustion, so I
take her to the infirmary
to rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Sorry for worrying you. Thanks for
always looking
out for me.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I think I'll just rest my eyes for a while...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Huh? Why am I on a stage?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: And why am I wearing this?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Sniff... Hic...
(Is someone crying?)
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: (Wait. I'm on a stage, there's an audience before me, and I'm under a spotlight. This can only mean one thing!)
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oh, my beloved pony, why do you cry
so?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Ah, that voice!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I took so long to find you. I've
come to
wipe away your tears, my love!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... No need to push. Everyone can
get an
autograph.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: So, it was just a dream... I had a feeling...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm glad I haven't lost my touch and
was able
to ad-lib my lines the second I
realized I was on
stage.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Are you all right? Why are you crying in
a place
like this?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: That's the wrong line!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume

text_block_list.text: What? Then, uh... I-I mean...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... It was just a dream...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I used to get nightmares like that all the
time as a
kid, where I blank on my lines
in the middle of a
show...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I guess the anxiety is the same, even
though I've
traded the stage of the
theatre for the turf... Ugh,
I don't feel
rested at all...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
All right. Seems like I'm back at full
charge. ♪
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
